item.title: Patch: M365 Manager Plus Privilege Escalation Can Lead to Remote Code Execution
item.description:
M365 Manager Plus Privilege Escalation: RCE · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for M365 Manager Plus Privilege Escalation. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
